dialog.speaker: npc:clerk
dialog.en: Your appointment was 10:40. It's 10:50. The system has marked you as a no-show.

dialog.speaker: npc:clerk
dialog.en: You're here, I can see that. The system can't.

choices.en: Wait for the end of the day

ikna.tr: Görevli adını iki hastanın arasına elle yazdı. Yirmi dakika sonra içerideydin.
ikna.en: The clerk wrote your name in by hand between two patients. Twenty minutes later you were inside.

coach.en: A handwritten name outranked the system.

ikna.tr: Görevli ekranı sana çevirdi. Adının yanında kırmızıyla "gelmedi" yazıyordu. Arkandaki sıra uzadı.
ikna.en: The clerk turned the screen toward you. Next to your name, in red: "no-show." The line behind you grew.

coach.en: The red text was not persuaded.

bekle.tr: Gün sonunu bekledin. 16.50'de son hasta olarak girdin. Muayenede iki yorgun kişi vardı.
bekle.en: You waited for the end of the day. At 4:50 you went in as the last patient. The consultation involved two tired people.

coach.tr: On dakika gecikme, altı saat bekleme.
coach.en: Ten minutes late, six hours waiting.

yeni.tr: Yeni randevu on dokuz gün sonraya verildi. Bu kez telefona üç alarm kurdun.
yeni.en: The next slot was nineteen days out. This time you set three alarms.

coach.tr: Üç alarm. On dokuz gün var.
coach.en: Three alarms. Nineteen days to go.

slip.en: WAGER: The system wins this one. — M.

intent.setup: randevuya on dakika geç kalınca sistemin "gelmedi" yazması
